offering_description.value: Enovis sells braces, rehabilitation equipment, therapeutic footwear and joint implants to healthcare providers and patients. It designs and manufactures orthopedic devices and supplies them through clinical sales teams, distributors and online channels.

primary_products.value: Orthopedic braces and supports; rehabilitation equipment; therapeutic footwear; joint replacement implants; orthopedic surgical instruments

primary_services.value: Orthopedic equipment program management and patient billing for clinics

customer_segment.value: B2B: Orthopedic practices, hospitals, surgery centers, physical therapy clinics and medical equipment suppliers; B2C: Patients and consumers buying braces, supports or therapeutic footwear

end_markets.value: Orthopedic rehabilitation; sports medicine; podiatry; joint replacement surgery

revenue_model.value: product sales: Braces, rehabilitation equipment, therapeutic footwear, implants and surgical instruments; healthcare reimbursement: Insurer payments for covered braces and other durable medical equipment supplied to patients

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns materials and components into orthopedic devices for clinicians, distributors and patients; service provider: Manages equipment inventories and patient billing for orthopedic practices

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Orthopedic injury prevention and rehabilitation, therapeutic footwear, and joint reconstruction

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Clinical sales teams serving orthopedic practices, hospitals and surgery centers; distributors / dealers: Medical device and orthopedic equipment distributors; online: Consumer storefronts for braces and supports

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Orthopedic medical devices subject to FDA requirements and the EU Medical Device Regulation

notes: The current size ranking of its prevention and recovery and reconstructive segments is uncertain.
